_about: Birth dates for the 'Emerging' label only (the ranking never uses age). Covers every signable player ranked above average under pressure, the whole pool the top 10 and the watch list are drawn from. Full dates are given for players born near the cutoff (1 April 2001: under 26 at the start of IPL 2027, the IPL Emerging Player age test) and were checked against public profiles (Wikipedia, ICC, Wisden, ESPNcricinfo). A year alone is given where the player is clearly older than the cutoff.
